bundle.shortDescription: Demo of the OpenCoven Chat familiars surface.
bundle.longDescription: OpenCoven Chat Demo opens straight into the Familiars Redesign: held actions, the ward at the centre of the chat, summoning familiars, @-mentions, and a familiar's screen. It connects to nothing and keeps nothing; every reply is local mock data.
